name: whoosh
title: Whoosh
summary: Sonic Pi's beep by another name.
description: A test synth: Sonic Pi's beep by another name, described by its own metadata. Its opts say their type, range and what they do.

note.doc: The note to play: a MIDI number or a note's name.

pan.doc: Where in the stereo field: -1 left, 1 right.

attack.doc: How long it takes to reach its full level.

decay.doc: How long it takes to fall from the attack level to the sustain level.

sustain.doc: How long it holds at the sustain level.

release.doc: How long it takes to fade out.

attack_level.doc: The level it reaches at the end of the attack.

sustain_level.doc: The level it holds during the sustain.

decay_level.doc: The level it falls to at the end of the decay: the sustain level unless set.
